staff_memberships_roles.name: staff_memberships_roles
staff_memberships_roles.value:
cardinality("staff_memberships"."roles") between 1 and 5 and "staff_memberships"."roles" <@ array['owner', 'doctor', 'reception', 'nurse', 'accountant']
        and cardinality("staff_memberships"."roles") = ('owner' = any("staff_memberships"."roles"))::int + ('doctor' = any("staff_memberships"."roles"))::int
          + ('reception' = any("staff_memberships"."roles"))::int + ('nurse' = any("staff_memberships"."roles"))::int
          + ('accountant' = any("staff_memberships"."roles"))::int

staff_memberships_invitation.name: staff_memberships_invitation
staff_memberships_invitation.value: "staff_memberships"."status" <> 'invited' or ("staff_memberships"."invitation_expires_at" is not null and "staff_memberships"."invitation_message_status" is not null)

platform_users_active_is_set_up.name: platform_users_active_is_set_up
platform_users_active_is_set_up.value: "platform_users"."status" <> 'active' or ("platform_users"."password_hash" is not null and "platform_users"."totp_secret" is not null)

tenants_status_reason.name: tenants_status_reason
tenants_status_reason.value: ("tenants"."status_reason" is not null) = ("tenants"."status" in ('suspended', 'closed')) and ("tenants"."status_reason" is null or "tenants"."status_reason" in ('non_payment', 'other'))
